notes.title: Announcing Rusty's Retirement - a relaxing idle-farming game!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/9d2225992e300ef2e461eff1e0bcc13d05cf12d0.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666510/Rustys_Retirement/

Rusty's Retirement is an idle-farming simulator designed to sit at the bottom of your screen allowing you to work on other tasks while caring for your farm!

Following the main events of Haiku the Robot, our beloved traveler, Rusty has been set with the task of repopulating the earth with biological life. Join him and other characters from the main game.

Grow crops:
Plant crops and watch Rusty get to work as he waters, nurtures, and harvests. Unlock new crops as you progress, from crispy carrots to ripe tomatoes.

Produce biofuel:
Use crops to produce clean and energy-efficient biofuel, a vital robot power source. Sell biofuel to other machine inhabitants and reinvest the money into expanding your farm.

Automate with robots:
Deploy a team of cute little robots to assist with planting, watering, and harvesting. Customize and upgrade your helper bots to increase efficiency.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/539eef9ea43426a8ba9f439bcd01a47a3c97acae.png
Multitasking:
Rusty's Retirement is built to sit comfortably at the bottom of your screen allowing you to do other tasks while caring for your farm. Zoom in or out for a less distracting view, or alternatively turn on 'Focus Mode' which slows down crop production.

Ultra-wide screen support:
The game is designed to fit all screens, from normal laptop-size to ultra-wide monitor screens. Toggle 'Always on top' if you never want to lose sight of your farm's progress.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666510/Rustys_Retirement/

notes.title: One-year Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
Hey folks, today marks the one-year anniversary of Haiku's release!

I've put together a short video to look back at this wonderful year, and also to showcase what's to come in the future for the game.

[previewyoutube=H46l1B8JhBk;full][/previewyoutube]

To summarize the video

Achievements:

 Successfully launching a game on Steam
 Having more than 1000 reviews (91% positive)
 Getting married!
 Attending PAX West and meeting people
 Launching the game on the Nintendo Switch
 Releasing a free update - Corrupt Mode
 Raising over $50,000 for charity with Humble Bundle
 Winning three awards; Best Solo-dev Game, Hidden Gem, and Best Estonian Game of 2022
 And learning to speedrun my own game in 36 minutes

Still to come:

 A new update - Obscure Information!
 Kickstarter rewards
 And a physical edition for the Nintendo Switch!!

Thank you!

I also want to take a moment to thank you, the people who played and enjoyed this little game of mine, your words and reactions have motivated me to keep working hard on the game. I cannot wait to see what the future holds for Haiku and more games down the line! ːorange_heartː

notes.content:

With the virus now flowing through your circuit board, you are more vulnerable with only one health point - if you die, you will respawn at the last unlocked repair station.

Temporary health upgrades are also available to help you overcome some of the more difficult challenges in the game. Additionally, the core game has two new train stations; one in the most requested [spoiler]Central Core[/spoiler], and one in the [spoiler]Sunken Wastes[/spoiler].

notes.title: Build 1.0.268
notes.content:
Apologies for the inconvenience regarding Steam achievements. A player sent me their savefile through Discord and after having a look around I found what was causing the issue.

I had made a few adjustments to the save system in preparation for the Nintendo Switch release, and subsequentially this affected how some achievements are triggered. Lesson learned for the future!

When booting up a savefile, the game will run a check on that savefile to see if there are any missing achievements. This applies to the majority of the achievements, except the following:


 For Safekeeping
 Mundooooo
 The Last Of Humankind
 In Too Deep
 Poetic Justice
 The Graveyard Shift
 Beep - Bop
 Two Points!
 Evolution

For these, you will have to revisit these areas to trigger them. I hope this helps you 100% the game!

notes.title: 1-Month Update and Limited Time Plushie!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

It's been a little over a month since the game launched and I'm blown away by the response it's received!

This is my first commercial project, so it's been an incredible feeling to watch Streamers play with their audiences, speedrunners break and tear the code apart, and modders start making mods for the game. Not to mention the 94% positive reviews out of ~600 on Steam!

This whole experience has been incredibly humbling, I can't wait to bring the game to the Nintendo Switch, and to release some more content updates.


Limited Edition Haiku Plushie!

Haiku the Robot is now available as a plushie for a limited time only! The design features super soft fabric and a velcro detachable sword. Haiku is leaving the world of Arcadia behind and possibly coming to your house to explore!

More information can be found here: https://shop.makeship.com/3Gib1GD
Plushies are limited edition and can only be ordered until June 23rd!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/0e3f9a19cff1b312e1d2328c9e5b1d3feac65b42.png

notes.title: Haiku the Robot is out now!
notes.content:
It's finally here! Haiku the Robot has officially released on Steam ːorange_heartː

I can only hope you enjoy the game. The last year and a half of development have been great, and I've genuinely enjoyed the entire process of making it. A special thank you to the Kickstarter community for making this project come to life!

[previewyoutube=j2DWMQ_USxg;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
Bug fixing

While there are no major game-breaking issues with the game, it is still very possible that there are some minor bugs that we haven't caught yet. Over the next few weeks, I am dedicating my time to squishing any remaining bugs.

If you do encounter a bug, I would appreciate it if you could report it here, and I will fix it as soon as possible: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1231880/discussions/0/3275815819058831873/

A friend once said to me; that there are always bugs, you just haven't found them yet!

Future plans

- Free Boss Rush DLC: This funded stretch goal from the Kickstarter campaign will include more bosses, and a challenging gauntlet of boss fights one after another.

- More languages: Currently, the game supports English, Spanish (Latam), and Portuguese (Brazil). There are plans to add more languages in the near future.

- Nintendo Switch: While the release date is still to be announced, I have been periodically testing the Switch port throughout development, and everything seems to run smoothly. I hope that it won't be long until I can confirm a release date.

[hr][/hr]

Thank you, I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: DEV UPDATE 02: Introducing the Heat Gauge!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I hope all is well. The sun has finally started to show its face in Estonia so that makes me a happy little fellow. In this update, I'll be revealing one of the new mechanics in the game: the Heat Gauge!

Heat Gauge showcase video
[previewyoutube=L0nJxnGnuYE;full][/previewyoutube]
The Heat Gauge shows how much you have heated when using your robot abilities. If you get too hot then you will become overheated and you will need to wait a short period until you fully cool down. Once you have cooled off, you will be able to use all your abilities again.
On top of the auto-cooling system, hitting enemies also cools you down faster. This promotes a slightly more aggressive playstyle for players who like that kind of thing.
[hr][/hr]

Abilities and costs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/a683bd0aeb8ded3d5f8ff0505bb7153702124e77.gif

Slide + dodge: Haiku can now slide across the floor to dodge and pass through enemies. This uses 1/3rd of your heat gauge. You can also use this ability to get around faster but be careful not to overheat yourself!
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/9233244c614ecf90235c084f1b213b09fefbe24a.gif

Blink + teleport: Later on, you will gain the ability to blink through time and space. This replaces the slide and dodge which can only be used on the floor. With this ability, you can also teleport through some world objects and use it while airborne.
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/da7f9f2c47b919be8dada862b769cd106bb7e5a9.gif

Super bomb: Haiku can use his inner-circuitry to create a quick explosion that deals triple damage in a small radius. It can also be used to unblock some paths in the world. This ability generates 2/3rds of heat.
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/4b809748584e55aa937c619f3eb45281996c126b.gif

Zipline: A late-game ability that helps you travel through previously explored areas a bit faster. Currently, used to travel horizontally and upwards. This ability uses 1/3rd of your heat gauge.
[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/1d48846388bcb03a23c609330b6fc5ce074b988e.gif

Attacking enemies: Haiku can cool down faster if he attacks nearby enemies. This means you can create different combos of attacking, bombing, and dodging while you manage your heat resource bar.
[hr][/hr]

Environment interactions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/8a57e4a8b36a288e0dd8a67b23a2e34625bcc376.gif

Different environments affect your heat gauge. For example, when traveling through the incinerator area then you will become persistently overheated.

[hr][/hr]
I want to hear your ideas!
Let me know in the comment section if you have any thoughts or ideas on how the Heat Gauge should be used. It could be interesting upgrades that cool your heat gauge faster or new abilities that you think would tie in nicely with the design.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE 01: Progress is good
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm Jordan, the solo-developer behind Haiku, the Robot.

I've been working full-time on the game for approximately 3 months now (thanks to a successful Kickstarter campaign) and I wanted to share some snapshots of the progress that's been made so far.

A lot of work has been going into planning the map (which is the most important part of a good Metroidvania), the levels, and passing them all over to Unity game engine. I haven't focused on environment details yet so the screenshots are demonstrating what I like to call a "first pass" - which means a quick dressing of the room to set the tone and mood.

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/d82803ef05f38e7152d3971d5b735bc91f2a0790.png
The Ruins (a working title)
This is one of my favorite areas in the game. It's so different from the normal machine world that Haiku lives in and it offers a nice change of pace and scenery while exploring. This is an exciting area which I can't wait to dedicate more time to and fill out with small details and story elements.

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/e9af11a55bc8c888ccbdbee7aa48e1f1cea2f158.png
The Incinerator (a working title)
This is definitely one of the more intense areas of the game. Here, the flames burn fiercely as garbage is consumed to produce power/electricity. One of the next steps for this area is to add fire-type enemies, some interesting platforming, and potentially a [spoiler]boss fight[/spoiler]!

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/01185e4c760a21c315d7a5cd5c2ad8f760a36fb3.png
The Core
This area acts as the central hub. Pretty much everything in Haiku's world needs electricity to function so it branches off into many different areas, The Incinerator being one of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/c44503d3d08e3dd470a0b8ad06d909810bb0448f.png

As I am close to finishing transferring all the levels into Unity's game engine, I've started to work on trickier platforming as well. It's fun coming up with ways to introduce new platform mechanics to the player, teaching them, and then testing their abilities - I hope it adds another layer to the gameplay while you explore. (Screenshot above)

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040504/5463ab119c925977437fcd41f282e1df1b18218d.png
Steampunk Town
After I've finished moving over the last few levels to Unity, I can start to design and add more details to the world, such as this cute little town (which is still missing characters). I will also be able to focus more time on new bosses, enemies, and story elements to further enrich the experience.

[hr][/hr]
Which area are you most excited for? Let me know in the comments below.


Overall, the game's progress is going very well. And things seem to be on schedule for my initial October launch plan but there is still a long road ahead. Watch this space as I will make sure to post more development updates in the future. Thanks!

[hr][/hr]
